description: Recognition history: each matched command's phrase, with the margins the confidence floor is tuned against. Off until you turn it on; kept 30 days. The History HUD shows recent matches either way, from memory. Append-only recognition log, keyed as a compacted changelog (id_strategy: by_field id, merge: authoritative). Every matched command is introduced with its dispatched action, active mode, per-word margin (worst + mean), and an empty verdict; the server mints the record's `id` and returns it. Flagging a row as a mishear in the History HUD annotates the SAME id with verdict="wrong" (append_keyed), which folds onto the match on a compacted read. Analysis reads the folded records: verdict empty = the margin population, "wrong" = confirmed confusers. Drives the confidence floor.
